items.title: Keralam mulling community-based system for early identification of at-risk children, providing support
items.excerpt: FOLKS – Friends of Little Kids is envisaged as a structured child protection early warning and intervention initiative that aims at connecting vulnerable children with the formal child protection system without delays.
items.author: The Hindu
